=== Round 3 — Lifting the Trophy ===

The Infodays trophy vault is gated by an RSA signature scheme.
An audit leaked the public key. The private exponent was picked
suspiciously small 'for performance'.

Hint: notice how big e is relative to n. When the private
exponent d is small enough (roughly d < n^0.25 / 3), there is
a classical attack that recovers d from the continued-fraction
expansion of e/n. Then decryption is ordinary: m = c^d mod n.
